hero.sub: A Vancouver-based studio building products that make ordinary moments better — and running our company on AI to do it.

who.quotePre: We believe AI’s highest purpose is
who.body1: Metis AI Research was founded in Vancouver on the belief that the AI era demands companies that build with care. Our mission is to revolutionize how people live and work through innovative, AI-powered solutions.
who.body2: Whether it’s personalized learning, intelligent assistants, or tools that simplify complex tasks, we focus on creating seamless experiences that elevate daily interactions — and stay out of the way when they should.
who.body3: We believe in the transformative potential of AI to positively impact every aspect of life, and we’re building quietly toward that future.

arotaro.tagline: A mental wellness companion — tarot, astrology, and fortune telling in a safe space to talk through whatever’s on your mind. Counselling at your fingertips, 24/7.
arotaro.mockUser1: I’ve been feeling stuck lately. Can you pull a card?
arotaro.mockAi1: Of course. Take a breath — I drew The Star for you. It’s a sign of quiet hope after a hard stretch. What feels heaviest right now?
arotaro.mockUser2: Work. I can’t tell if I’m burnt out or just lost.

blinc.tagline: Every loyalty card, one tap away. Blinc keeps your rewards and membership cards in one fast, private place — tap a card and the barcode fills the screen, ready to scan. Works offline, no account needed, and your cards never leave your phone.

howWeBuild.name: Metis OS
howWeBuild.body1: Metis OS is the operating system we built to run Metis. It’s where our AI employees work alongside us — answering questions, writing the morning numbers, planning roadmaps, and keeping every product we run in good shape.
howWeBuild.body2: It’s how a team our size ships and operates more than one product, and it’s where we learn first-hand what working with AI actually takes. Those lessons go straight back into everything we build.

pillars.title: AI employees
pillars.body: Agents with installable skills that research, answer, and write — on request or on a schedule.

pillars.title: Reports you can trust
pillars.body: Daily digests built from queries a person approved, so the numbers mean the same thing every day.

pillars.title: Roadmaps, planned together
pillars.body: Agents triage feedback and propose plans. A person approves before anything gets built.

pillars.title: One door to every product
pillars.body: The operating surface for each product we run — arotaro and Blinc included.

howWeBuild.shotAlt: Metis OS showing the Blinc project: the integrations its AI employees can use, shared by the team or connected for Blinc alone.
howWeBuild.meta: INTERNAL · IN DAILY USE AT METIS

principles.title: AI should feel inevitable, not impressive.
principles.body: The best technology disappears. We don’t build demos for the AI era — we build products that feel obvious in hindsight, the kind you can’t imagine living without a month after using them.

principles.title: Personalization is a craft, not a feature.
principles.body: Every product we create is shaped to your actual life — whether for learning, productivity, or wellbeing. Generic AI is loud; personal AI is quiet and precise. We choose precision.

principles.title: Small teams with strong taste outperform big teams with big budgets.
principles.body: We are a small team, supported by Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub, building with focus and conviction. The future belongs to teams that care about details other people skip.
